# Gallachers Car Garage

> Gallachers Car Garage is a family-run auto repair centre in Blantyre, South Lanarkshire, Scotland. We provide honest, expert car and van repairs at fair prices, rated 4.8/5 by customers.

## Business details

- Address: Unit 7a, 7b Forrest Street, Blantyre, Glasgow G72 0JP, Scotland
- Phone: 01698 711111
- Email: dgallachers@hotmail.com
- Opening hours: Monday–Thursday 8:00am–5:00pm, Friday 8:00am–4:00pm, closed Saturday and Sunday
- Areas served: Blantyre, Hamilton, Bothwell, Uddingston, Cambuslang, East Kilbride and South Lanarkshire
- Vehicles: all makes and models of cars, plus vans and light commercial vehicles up to 3.5 tonnes
